title: Funky Additions
description: funny things, a great addition to your world!
body:
Hello, Welcome to Funny Additions!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What does this mod add? it adds:
>  A new ore called Gabbro (based on a real life rock, just more shiny and fictional than it looks IRL)

>  A duplicator, Yes you heard it right! a duplicator!

>  **LETTUCE**

>  lettuce seeds

>  a naturaly occuring Lettuce Plant

>  **BREAD AND LETTUCE, THE MOST OP FOOD EVER.**

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ok so, why would you download this mod if it doesn't have many things?
well, _**because it is like a tiny sapling on the top of a mountain, it must take a while to grow**_ and get more features, but rn it is tiny, but you can download right now and get it on the early versions!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

the dependencies at the moment:

1. ~~the best mod ever~~ [Dirt Armor and Tools](https://modrinth.com/mod/dirt-armor-and-tools) 

2. Forge on the minecraft version 1.20.1
